text: {"contradictions":[{"source":"གང་གི་ཕྱིར་དོན་དམ་པར་དག་ཅིང་མྱ་ངན་ལས་འདས་པ་དེའི་དངོས་པོ་མེད་དོ། །","english":"Since it is ultimately pure and in Nirvana, it is not an entity.","kind":"sense","why":"The source says the entity does not exist (is empty) because it is pure/Nirvana, but the English phrasing is ambiguous or potentially reversed in logic.","certainty":"medium"}],"omissions":[],"additions":[]}

contradictions.english: Since it is ultimately pure and in Nirvana, it is not an entity.
contradictions.why: The source says the entity does not exist (is empty) because it is pure/Nirvana, but the English phrasing is ambiguous or potentially reversed in logic.
